text:
Priya Rao: Heads up — Sheridan Energy (acct: SRE-983) down ~40% QoQ on API calls; main procurement/technical champion (CTO Marcus Lee) left last week. Sales flagged a competitor pilot (LumenAI). Putting triage here. Thoughts?
Ethan Cole: Yikes. Do we have concrete numbers and any errors/incidents? Link to console?
Priya Rao: Quick snapshot:
```
30d API calls: 24,300 (prev 41,000)
Active seats: 18 -> 11
Monthly spend: $18.2k -> $12.4k
Top endpoint usage: /generate (down 55%)
```
Dashboard: https://console.redwood/customers/SRE-983
No incidents in last 30d, but they pinged about latency hits on long prompts two weeks ago.
Zara Kim: Confirmed — sales mentioned LumenAI PoC starts 2025-04-05. Did they say why? price/latency/feature?
Priya Rao: Sales notes: cheaper TCO + promise of "real-time" latency. Also new procurement lead (CPO) evaluating TCO. Champion was Marcus; now Aisha (VP Eng) still in place but less influence than Marcus was.
Victor (CSE): I'd propose: 1) quick cost-savings analysis comparing our Dedicated config vs Lumen price, 2) offer 2-week burst credits + one performance tuning session, 3) schedule a short QBR with execs. We should quantify token-level savings using Optimize.
Ethan Cole: I can do a short infra audit — 30m with their infra engs this week. I can run probing prompts to demonstrate batching/quant benefits and potential latency improvements.
Priya Rao: @Ethan please take that. @Victor can you draft the offer email (credits + tuning) by EOD tomorrow?
OnboardingBot: Suggested playbook: churn_watch v2 — immediate steps: (1) confirm decision timeline, (2) secure executive QBR, (3) deploy fast optimization audit, (4) offer limited credits, (5) capture competitor differentiators. Internal link: /playbooks/churn_watch
Zara Kim: I'll reach out to Aisha to reconfirm champion map and procurement cadence.
Sales-Bot: Sale owner: Jamie Tran — last activity 3 days ago; notes: pilot interest from Lumen recorded.
Priya Rao: Plan: Ethan — infra audit this Thu, Victor — offer draft by EOD tomorrow, Zara — champion + procurement confirmation, I'll schedule QBR for next Tue and loop Jamie. Update thread with outcomes by Friday COB. :thumbsup:
Ethan Cole: On it.
Victor (CSE): Will have draft by 5pm PT tomorrow.
Zara Kim: Reaching out now.
Priya Rao: Thanks team — we have to move fast; keeping this as highest priority for CS next week.
